question: Do the s077/s079 competing basins survive a hi-fi rho-band gate, and what is the actual searchable form of the hi-fi Band A-union-B multi-solution set?
hypothesis: Retiring the loose-surrogate caveat: some competing basins survive at hi-fi rho<4; the surviving multi-solutions are instances of a low-dimensional searchable form (tested: same-polhode/free-L-direction vs omega-scaling).
narrative_md: Rendered hi-fi the 145 truth + competing basins from the s077 substrate. Truth control 41/41 Band A; surrogate<->hi-fi 145/145 exact band agreement (retires the loose-surrogate caveat). Of 104 competing basins, 30 land hi-fi Band A-union-B, all distinct (no body-X twins). The searchable form (Group A, 19 endpoints) is omega-MAGNITUDE scaling (d_2T~d_L2~2*L_mag_rel signature), NOT the s077 same-polhode/free-L-direction form — so 'fix omega-direction, sweep |omega| and q0-offset', recoverable given a near-truth omega-direction. s079 LAM/SAM split holds (28/2). Renders vs truth + truth-basin control + truth-omega-seeded polish -> oracle_clean false.
